one_liner: Ranks every number by the count over all earlier draws, pulled towards the fair rate by a prior worth 52 fair draws.
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_7 looks at each number on its own. It counts how often each number was drawn in all earlier draws, then pulls that rate towards the fair-draw rate as if 52 perfectly fair draws had been added, so a short lucky run counts for less. Over the full history it picks exactly the same numbers as E_1, apart from the order of exact ties; its point is its chances, which are pulled further towards fair than E_6's. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its values are model-based chances of each number being drawn, not tested for calibration. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 1 earlier draw. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
